features.title: FRQ-01 Control TV channel order and essentials
features.summary: TV channel order is fixed in code: orderChannels() sorts at runtime by guide, favourites, stream health and then title, and ESSENTIAL_BRANDS decides at sync time which channels are 'essential'. Make the order and the essentials set deliberate and easy to change.
features.summary_of_intent: User: 'Order: edit orderChannels() for runtime order, or ESSENTIAL_BRANDS for what counts as essential'
scope: scripts/iptv-parse.mjs — ESSENTIAL_BRANDS and the toItems() snapshot sort

verification.check: pnpm run check — 60/60 tests, typecheck and lint clean (2026-10-24); new ordering tests in test/media.test.js
verification.browser: Chrome via Playwright against pnpm run dev: ?scope=watch grid opens BBC One Scotland · BBC News South Asia · BBC News Asia Pacific · ITV2 · ITV3 · ITV4 · Channel 4 · Channel 5 · E4 · More4 · 5USA · Sky News Weather · GB News (config pin order, offline pinned kept), then essentials StarPlus · CNBC UK · DAZN Combat. watch 144 / listen 29 / all 173 cards, no duplicates, no console errors. Screenshot docs/screenshots/frq-01-watch-order.png.
verification.regression: Radio order compared against main's orderChannels on public/catalogue.json (with and without listings): identical, 29 items.

features.title: FRQ-02 Channel config file to pin, hide and add TV channels
features.summary: A committed config (e.g. scripts/iptv-config.json) applied during sync:iptv. It has a pinned list of ids in display order, a hide list of ids, and an add list of known-good streams iptv-org lacks or filters out. Gives manual control over the catalogue without editing parser code.
features.summary_of_intent: User: 'can i control the order and get rid of some' — chose 'Channel config (pin/hide/add)' when asked which IPTV problems to add to the feature list.

verification.check: pnpm run check — 56/56 tests, typecheck and lint clean (2026-10-24); 8 new tests in test/iptv-config.test.js
verification.sync: pnpm sync:iptv — 144 channels, 13 pinned/0 hidden/0 added; seed pin ids ITV1.uk and SkyNews.uk were flagged as unmatched and corrected; pnpm sync:iptv --check then passed twice
verification.browser: Chrome via Playwright against pnpm run dev, ?scope=watch&view=channels: with hide:[StarPlus.uk] and one add entry, StarPlus absent from grid and search, added channel rendered, health 'ok' and played (video readyState 4, 6.6s elapsed), no console errors. Screenshot docs/screenshots/frq-02-config-added-playing.png. Temporary config reverted.

next_steps: Merge with PR. Pinned positions are in iptv.json but not yet reflected in UI order — that is frq-01.

features.title: FRQ-03 YouTube-style TV player: overlay controls, inline + mini player, sticky mobile
features.summary: Move full screen and other controls onto the video, play TV inline in the card with a docked miniplayer, and pin the player under the top bar on mobile so pressing play always shows the video.
features.summary_of_intent: User: 'i would like the tv player to behave like the leading stream sites eg youtube. where the fullscreen toggle is overlaying the video. pressing play should get the player oupuput windows in focus on mobile. it should be possible to launch the stream without going into the full open window' — chose both inline-in-card and miniplayer, and sticky top player on mobile.
scope: app/public/entry.tsx — player modes, overlay controls, fullscreen
public/styles.css — overlay, inline tile, mini video, sticky mobile stage

verification.check: pnpm run check — 60/60 tests, typecheck and lint clean (2026-10-24). No new unit tests: the mode logic is UI-bound in entry.tsx; covered by the browser checks below.
verification.browser: Chrome via Playwright against pnpm run dev, ?scope=watch&view=channels. Desktop 1366×860: Afrobeat TV played inside its card (readyState 4, no stage); scrolled away → docked in bottom bar, still playing; scrolled back → inline; ⤢ → stage with overlay controls; ⛶ and `f` → .player-frame is document.fullscreenElement with controls visible; controls go idle after 3 s and wake on pointer move; `k` pauses. Guide view → mini; Listen scope keeps the TV mini; playing radio shows no stage/mini video. Phone 390×844 touch: Brit Asia TV from mid-grid → sticky 16:9 player at top:0 immediately and still pinned after scrolling 900px; collapse → mini thumbnail keeps playing (videoWidth 1920). Failed ITV2 shows 'Stream unavailable' over the stage. Only console error: one geo-blocked logo ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED (pre-existing). Screenshots docs/screenshots/frq-03-*.png.

next_steps: Unverified: real iOS Safari (webkitEnterFullscreen fallback, orientation lock) — needs a device check.
